main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a key ✝️ to Awakening ❤️
header_desc: By intertwining 1st-century spirituality with 21st-century physics, this work addresses the fundamental question about our place in the Universe. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in texts that are two thousand years old: the Gnostic gospels. The demiurgic ego has mass and creates the materio-temporal illusion; therefore, only through the feeling of Sophia can one access the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos.
left_title: Matter and Time ┻ : The Illusion of the Demiurge 🧠
left_body: Matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche 🧠, while the timeless belongs to the pneuma ❤️. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one invites the shedding of the false self to return to the flat light of the Invisible Father. Thus, the Pleroma is revealed as a flat spacetime in contrast to the material prison of curved spacetime, showing that the Christian cross is the key to awakening from the illusion of matter and time.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere lies the divine and timeless plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There is the land of unity and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside of you and it is outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3): the divine wisdom of Sophia in the right hemisphere versus the material ignorance of Yaldabaoth in the left hemisphere reveal the duality of human consciousness, granting us free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE✝️❤️ | EGO ┻🧠 ⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break with simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as the soul's entrapment. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and the Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The Orwellian doublethink mechanism (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation before the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of the cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a larger-than-normal white man, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes no sense to pray to the law of gravity
